name: Outreach Lead-Gen Pipeline
description: Daily income pipeline: prospect -> copywrite -> dispatch -> report. The prospector agent turns the campaign brief (workflow input) into a JSON {"prospects":[...]} array of verified, directory-deduped contacts. fan_out runs the copywriter once per prospect (maxConcurrency 2); the merged array of {email, subject, text} drafts reaches the dispatcher, which sends each through mcp__outreach__send_email - every hard rule (verified sourceUrl, never-contact domains, permanent opt-outs, IST window, daily cap, min interval, max 3 touches, compliance footer) is enforced inside the connector, not the prompts. The reporter emails the funnel digest to the operator. Requires the outreach MCP connector registered with OUTREACH_SMTP_*/OUTREACH_IMAP_*/OUTREACH_CORE_* env, and the four agents created (see scripts/income-pipeline/bootstrap-pipeline.sh). Replace all REPLACE_WITH_*_AGENT_ID placeholders before POSTing; then PUT /api/workflows/{id} with status ACTIVE and PUT /api/workflows/{id}/schedule (e.g. cron '30 4 * * *' = 10:00 IST).

data.label: Scheduled/manual trigger - input is the campaign brief (target audience)
Dispatcher: follow-ups first, then gated sends
